name: zrok Hosted Free
free_limit: 5 GB transfer per rolling 24 hours; 25 environments; 50 share backends; 50 private access frontends; public HTTPS and private sharing.
watch_out: Exceeding daily transfer suspends shares until usage falls below the limit. Public shares have 2,000 requests/IP and 7,500 requests/share per 5 minutes; free no-card accounts show an anti-phishing interstitial. Production SLAs and custom limits require commercial arrangements.
